messages:
erin_sales: Hey team — SilverLake returned the RFI with a few pre-POC asks. They want a capability matrix (hosted vs dedicated vs private), explicit HSM/KMS behavior, a 4-week Dedicated trial pricing & overage policy, and a proposed POC milestone plan. I uploaded the RFI here: https://drive.google.com/silverlake-rfi (internal). Need SME review by EOD so we can lock the SOW.

raj_engineer: Got it. Quick clarification — they listed 40k tokens/sec peak in the doc. Is that aggregate or sustained? Also they want KV cache persistence across sessions.

erin_sales: SilverLake's note: "40k tokens/sec peak across the service during load tests; avg user sessions 1k–2k TPS." They called out quantized model preference for cost reasons and requested 99.9% availability target for the POC period.

katie_se: 40k aggregate is doable but not with default host tier. Recommendation: Dedicated reserved pool with sticky routing + autoscale for bursts. For HSM: we can support BYO-HSM if they go Private; hosted doesn't expose HSM. I'll draft the capability matrix and a minimal perf config.

michael_ops: Ops notes: Private + HSM requires network peering + IP allowlist + customer-managed tunnel to on-prem HSM. Setup estimate: infra prep 2w, provisioning & peering 1w, smoke tests 1w. Load testing and tuning another 2w. So ~6w end-to-end if they want full Private.

sam_sales: Pricing ask: suggest 4-week Dedicated trial: flat $18k reserved pool + usage at standard token rates; include an optional annual commit with 20% discount. We can also offer a short-term burst credit for the first week. Thoughts?

raj_engineer: Tech caveat: KV cache persistence across sessions requires sticky routing to stateful nodes and increased memory. Expect a 8–12% throughput reduction unless we increase batch sizes or add more GPUs. I can propose two configs (latency-optimized vs cost-optimized) with throughput numbers.

katie_se: Capability matrix (brief snippet):

```
Host: fast onboarding, shared KMS, no HSM, 99.5% SLA, streaming support
Dedicated: reserved GPUs, sticky routing (prefix cache), 99.9% SLA, BYO-HSM via Private peering option
Private: customer VPC, full HSM support, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs retention configurable, longer setup
```

maria_csm: We also need a demo dataset and sample payloads from SilverLake (redacted). Ask them for max seq len, sample QPS patterns, and any PII markup rules so we can baseline evals.

legal_bot: Security/legal flag: remove "unlimited audit access" ask. Propose: audit logs retained for 90 days for POC and SOC2 addendum language. Also request a DPA + encryption-in-transit and at-rest standard clause. I'll draft a short security appendix.

erin_sales: Action items — @katie_se: update full capability matrix and attach spreadsheet; @raj_engineer: finalize perf profiles for latency vs cost configs; @michael_ops: confirm infra lead times and any firewall rules; @legal_bot: draft security appendix and DPA language; @sam_sales: prepare pricing slide and commit options. Target to send SilverLake a consolidated response by 2145390000. :thumbsup:

sam_sales: I'll assemble pricing + example SOW bullets. Also suggest we include a canary rollback policy and brief runbook for the POC so they feel comfortable with reliability.

katie_se: I'll drop the spreadsheet to the same drive folder and ping when ready. Expect a first draft in ~3 hours.

raj_engineer: I'll attach a short perf runbook and sample config (batch sizes, KV retention) in the doc. Need their sample payloads first to validate.

erin_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll keep SilverLake in the loop and push for the sample data. If we can hit the EOD target we should be in good shape for the SOW call tomorrow. :rocket:
